messages:
sara: FYI opened CS-9832 — customer on Dedicated saw p99 jump from ~350ms to ~1.8s after we onboarded Specter (model:specter-1.0, tokenizer:byte-specter-v1) :warning:

mike: which workload? long-context or regular chat?

sara: long-context batch of ~12 requests, avg seq length ~6k tokens. Only specter routes affected, fallback to specter-compact is fine.

alina: do we have KV cache misses in the logs? sounds like kvcache thrash. any spikes in cache eviction?

sara: attaching a small excerpt from runtime logs (sanitized):

```
[2026-02-18T14:12:03Z] request id=cs-9832 req_len=6120 route=specter-1.0 tokens_generated=0
[2026-02-18T14:12:03Z] kvcache: capacity=256MB used=251MB evictions=1124
[2026-02-18T14:12:03Z] tokenizer.byte-specter-v1: avg_piece_len=3.2 pieces=20500
[2026-02-18T14:12:04Z] runtime.batch: created 1 batch size=12 latency=1780ms
[2026-02-18T14:12:04Z] kernel_select: selected slowpath_attention
```

jordan: that evictions count is suspicious for steady workload. could be the tokenizer producing many subtokens (subword explosion) for long unicode spans.

mike: did we change tokenizer normalization rules for specter?

alina: yes, byte-specter-v1 made UTF8 normalization and aggressively split sequences to preserve fidelity, which increases token count for long texts (esp. mixed CJK + emoji).

sara: customer provided repro snippet (sanitized). they hit our hosted endpoint; here's a minimal curl they used: 

```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -d '{"model":"specter-1.0","input":"<long_document_with_mixed_unicode>" ,"max_tokens":1024}'
```

mike: trying the repro locally in canary — seeing p99 ~1.7s when tokenized to 20k pieces. if we treat same input with byte-legacy tokenizer it's 420ms and pieces ~4.5k.

jordan: so root cause = tokenizer producing 4-5x more tokens, causing kvcache pressure and slowpath kernels. two immediate mitigations: 1) roll tokenizer back for specter to legacy for affected customers; 2) enable model fallback route to specter-compact for long requests.

alina: also add a quick kvcache tuning: increase per-model kvcache to 512MB on Dedicated pools for specter while we triage. that reduces evictions.

sara: customer wants ETA and mitigation now. I proposed: rollback tokenizer for their account + temporary route override.

mike: action plan I can run now (requires ops approval):
- pin model route for customer to specter-1.0+byte-legacy via per-customer config
- increase kvcache allocation on their pool to 512MB
- enable request-length limit and return 413 for >30k tokenized pieces as safety

jordan: I'll prepare a canary with tokenization metrics exposed, add histogram for "pieces_per_input" and attach to console dashboards.

alina: for long-term fix: we should modify byte-specter-v1 normalization to merge common multicode grapheme sequences and limit per-runary splits. also add tokenization regression test with mixed-unicode long docs.

sara: sent customer note offering rollback now and ETA for follow-ups. they replied :thumbsup:.

deploy-bot: deployment request queued: kvcache increase -> pool-ded-12 (owner:mike) ; expected change window 10m.

mike: did the kvcache bump in pool-ded-12 (appliance). early telemetry shows evictions dropped from 1124 -> 32 for the same workload, p99 improved to ~480ms.

sara: customer confirmed perceived latency much better; will keep ticket open until we ship tokenizer patch.

jordan: next steps assigned:
- alina: tokenizer patch & unit tests (ETA 3d)
- mike: add per-model kvcache autoscale rule + short-term patch (done)
- jordan: dashboard + alert on pieces_per_input p95/p99 (ETA 1d)
- sara: coordinate customer comms and confirm rollback window closed (ongoing)

alina: small note — when we patch tokenizer, we must run evals against our regeneration/evals suite; some core prompts change tokenization which could affect pricing and regression thresholds.

mike: agree. we'll run a canary group and a 1% traffic rollout after tests.

sara: flagging internal follow-up doc PR: /docs/onboarding/specter-tokenizer-postmortem (will link once written).

jordan: marking thread resolved for immediate mitigation. keeping ticket CS-9832 open for the patch cycle. :white_check_mark:
